2026-09-25NRCANNuclear Liability and Compensation ActRegulations Amending the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Act and the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations Regulations Amending the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Act and the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations in order to (1) increase the liability limit for power reactors from $1 billion to $1.2 billion and adjust the limits for lower-risk installations to reflect inflation; (2) establish a liability limit class for commercial small modular reactors (SMRs) recognizing their lower-risk profile; and (3) update provisions to designate the Darlington New Nuclear Project (DNNP) as a nuclear installation under the schedule to the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations (NLCR), which will not come into force until a licence to operate is issued to the DNNP by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission (CNSC).Registration: SOR/2026-0198 Publication Date: 2026-10-07
subject: Regulations Amending the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Act and the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Act and the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations in order to (1) increase the liability limit for power reactors from $1 billion to $1.2 billion and adjust the limits for lower-risk installations to reflect inflation; (2) establish a liability limit class for commercial small modular reactors (SMRs) recognizing their lower-risk profile; and (3) update provisions to designate the Darlington New Nuclear Project (DNNP) as a nuclear installation under the schedule to the Nuclear Liability and Compensation Regulations (NLCR), which will not come into force until a licence to operate is issued to the DNNP by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission (CNSC).
